column1: # memfn/data/cards/kit-synthetic.tsv — the cards of the SYNTHETIC sets
# test inputs, never measured, so their method is no measurement. Every
# quantity a finder row (or its pay rule) reads has a card here, so a
# synthetic set holding every derivable key is on-card. The pay rule's
# operand quantities (delta, dfloor, cdisp_call, cfloor, ffloor, cdisp_use,
# ufloor, wfloor) are PROVISIONAL spellings (memfn/src/finder.c) until
# kit-synthetic@2 (lane setdig): @1 plus `beta`, the quantity of the unit row. @1 stays as
# committed: the loader refuses a synthetic set built on it (measures.md §3.1¶2: unit_key must
# name a row, and that row's quantity needs a card here, which @1 lacked).
